'''Lucid Dream''' is an [[Ornamental|Ornamental]] [[item]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.|"Alright. Time to give myself into dreamscape. It has been a long, tiring day. Giving the dreams some nonsensical fun seems like a pretty good choice."}}

==Usage==
An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
